mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and aminoglycosides (gentamicin) combined with glycopeptides (vancomycin) significantly increase risk of acute kidney injury and ototoxicity through additive renal and cochlear toxicity.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and vancomycin/gentamicin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; assess renal function baseline and frequently during therapy.
